principle: A citation is not a preserved source.

rules.rule: Every public-facing source-derived module must have a freeze state before display.
A source-page label may be stored as a label only until the link target and page context are frozen.
Resolved URL, redirect chain, content type, retrieved_at timestamp, byte length, and SHA-256 hash are required before content summary.
If a source disappears, the cube records a drift/dead-link event and keeps historical label custody; it does not delete the row.
No payload is public-bundled until privacy, redistribution, and harm-display gates clear.
